metaDescription: Pick a farm parcel by its number or on the map and continue to the water analysis.
title: Find a parcel

search.label: Parcel number, district with number or address
search.hint: Enter a parcel number, a district with a number or an address. You can also click a parcel on the map.
search.tooShort: Enter at least 3 characters, e.g. Dąbrowa 12.
search.tooLong: That text is too long. Enter a parcel number or a district and number.
search.failed: Could not search for the parcel
search.slow: Also searching for parcels with this number across Poland. This can take several seconds.

candidates.title: Choose your parcel
candidates.count: Found {total, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} with this number. Pick the right one by commune and county.
candidates.truncated: Showing the first {shown} of {total}. Narrow the list or enter the full parcel number.
candidates.none: We could not find a parcel with that number. Check the spelling or pick the parcel on the map.

preview.title: Check that this is the right parcel
preview.areaNote: Area calculated from the boundaries on the map. It may differ from the area in the land register.
preview.source: Parcel boundaries: {source, select, uldk {GUGiK (ULDK)} other {GUGiK (land register, WFS)}}, fetched {date}.
preview.alreadyAdded: This parcel is already on your list.
preview.listFull: The list holds at most {max} parcels. Remove one to add another.
preview.notFoundAtPoint: There is no cadastral parcel at this spot. Click somewhere else or enter a number.
preview.notFound: We could not find that parcel. Check the number or pick the parcel on the map.

list.title: My parcels
list.empty: You have no parcels yet. Search by number or click one on the map.
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No parcels} one {# parcel} other {# parcels}}
list.missing: Parcel {id} is not in the land register

analyze.disabledHint: Add a parcel to continue to the analysis.

map.label: Map. Click a parcel to pick it.
map.failed: Could not load the map. Searching by number still works.
map.zoomHint: Zoom in to pick a parcel.
map.boundariesHint: Parcel boundaries and numbers from the land register. They appear when you zoom in.
map.pickHint: Click your parcel on the map.
map.hydroHint: Drainage ditches, rivers, streams, canals, water bodies and wetlands from BDOT10k (GUGiK). Visible when zoomed in.

hydroLegend.title: Legend: ditches and streams
hydroLegend.truncated: Only some features are shown here – zoom in.
hydroLegend.zoom: Zoom in to see ditches and streams.
hydroLegend.unavailable: The ditches and streams layer is temporarily unavailable. The rest of the map works normally.

summary.title: Parcels to analyse
summary.description: Check the parcels, choose the crop and the day, and we will prepare the water assessment.
summary.emptyDescription: Go back to the map and add at least one parcel.

places.title: Addresses and places
places.hint: Choose a place. The map will go there and you can click your parcel.

field.intro: A parcel is not always a field
field.introDescription: Do you farm only part of a parcel, or does your field span several parcels? Mark the exact area on the map.
field.startSplit: Split a parcel with a line
field.splitNeedsOne: To split a parcel, keep exactly one parcel on the list.
field.title: Your own field
field.drawHelp: Tap the map at the corners of the field, one after another along its edge. The area closes itself between the last and the first point.
field.splitHelp: Tap two points on the map on both sides of where your field ends. The line through them will split parcel {number} into two parts.
field.points: {count, plural, =0 {No points} one {# point} other {# points}}
field.needMore: Add {count, plural, one {# more point} other {# more points}} to close the area.
field.maxPoints: The limit of {max} points has been reached.
field.selfIntersecting: The edges of the area cross. Undo the last point and place it elsewhere.
field.lineMissing: {count, plural, =0 {Tap the first point of the dividing line.} other {Tap the second point of the dividing line.}}
field.lineOutside: The line does not cross the parcel. Place the points on both sides of the edge of the part you farm.
field.analyzeHint: Mark an area on the map to continue to the analysis.
field.invalidArea: The area in the link cannot be read. Draw it again.

firstSteps.title: Check the water on your field in 3 steps

find.title: Find your parcel
find.text: Type the parcel number or an address, or click on the map.

crop.title: Choose the crop and day
crop.text: Today or any day in the last 10 years.

report.title: Read the report
report.text: Whether water is short, why, and what to do: hold water, change tillage, irrigate.
